terms.zh: 瘧疾
terms.en: Malaria

terms.zh: 利什曼原蟲
terms.en: Leishmaniasis

terms.zh: 戶外活動時，穿著淺色長袖衣褲、包鞋及長襪，儘量減少裸露部位
terms.en: Outdoors, wear light-coloured long sleeves and trousers, closed shoes and socks, and keep as little skin exposed as possible.

terms.zh: 正確使用防蚊蟲劑
terms.en: Use insect repellent correctly.

terms.zh: 選擇有空調、紗窗的旅館，或懸掛蚊帳(確認無破洞)，必要時噴灑環境用殺蟲或防蚊劑
terms.en: Choose accommodation with air conditioning or window screens, or sleep under a mosquito net without holes; spray insecticide or repellent in the room if needed.

terms.zh: 霍亂
terms.en: Cholera

terms.zh: 傷寒
terms.en: Typhoid fever

terms.zh: 選擇安全的食物
terms.en: Choose safe food.

terms.zh: 選擇衛生條件良好的用餐地點，如規模較大的飯店、沒有蟑螂蚊蠅的餐廳
terms.en: Eat where hygiene is good, such as larger hotels and restaurants without cockroaches or flies.

terms.zh: 狂犬病
terms.en: Rabies

terms.zh: 在當地應避免逗弄、餵食哺乳動物，並避免至可能有蝙蝠的洞窟，以免感染狂犬病
terms.en: Do not tease or feed mammals, and stay out of caves that may house bats, to avoid rabies.

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎是一種由蜱蟲傳播的疾病，蜱蟲多活動於森林、草原等有樹木、灌木或草地的地方，建議前往這些地點時加強防蟲措施
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis is spread by ticks, which live in forests, grassland and places with trees, bushes or grass: take extra care against bites when you go there.

terms.zh: 如遭蜱蟲叮咬，可以鑷子夾住蜱蟲前半部，垂直皮膚表面緩慢向上拔除，如無適當工具，建議就醫處理，以免口器斷裂於叮咬部位而造成感染
terms.en: If a tick bites you, grip its front end with tweezers and pull it slowly straight out of the skin; without proper tools, see a doctor so the mouthparts do not break off in the bite and cause infection.

terms.zh: 避免接觸河流、湖泊、池塘等淡水水域
terms.en: Avoid contact with fresh water such as rivers, lakes and ponds.

terms.zh: 使用河水、湖水洗澡或洗衣，建議添加氯錠消毒，或在乾淨容器至少儲放2天再使用
terms.en: If you wash or do laundry with river or lake water, add chlorine tablets, or keep the water in a clean container for at least 2 days before using it.

terms.zh: 如不慎碰觸淡水，請立即用酒精和乾毛巾大力擦拭皮膚，減低感染風險
terms.en: If your skin touches fresh water, rub it hard with alcohol and a dry towel straight away to lower the risk of infection.

terms.zh: 登革熱
terms.en: Dengue fever

terms.zh: 茲卡病毒感染症
terms.en: Zika virus infection

terms.zh: 茲卡病毒可由斑蚊叮咬傳播，一般旅客感染症狀較輕微，但孕婦感染可能導致胎兒小頭畸形或死亡，除採取上述防蚊措施外，建議懷孕婦女非必要應暫緩前往具流行風險之地區，孕婦及計劃懷孕婦女如必要前往請先諮詢醫師，於當地務必全程做好避免蚊蟲叮咬的措施
terms.en: Zika is spread by Aedes mosquitoes. Most travellers have mild symptoms, but infection in pregnancy can cause microcephaly or death of the baby. Besides the measures above, pregnant women should postpone non-essential travel to areas at risk; pregnant women and those planning a pregnancy who must go should consult a doctor first and avoid mosquito bites throughout the stay.

terms.zh: 黃熱病
terms.en: Yellow fever

terms.zh: 屈公病
terms.en: Chikungunya

terms.zh: M痘
terms.en: Mpox

terms.zh: 降低人際間傳播風險
terms.en: Reduce the risk of person-to-person spread.

terms.zh: 降低人畜共通傳播風險
terms.en: Reduce the risk of catching infections from animals.

terms.zh: 如有任何疑似症狀，應及時就醫，並告知旅遊史、高風險場域暴露史與接觸史
terms.en: If you have any suspicious symptoms, see a doctor promptly and tell them your travel history, high-risk exposures and contacts.

terms.zh: 登革熱(侷限在東北部昆士蘭州地區)
terms.en: Dengue fever (limited to north-eastern Queensland)

terms.zh: 日本腦炎
terms.en: Japanese encephalitis

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(2006年曾通報人類H5N1流感個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (a human H5N1 case was reported in 2006)

terms.zh: 新型A型流感大多由染病的禽類感染人類，在當地應避免出入有活禽的傳統市場、養殖場、鳥園，並避免接觸鳥類及其糞便、屍體
terms.en: Novel influenza A is mostly passed to people from infected poultry: stay away from live-poultry markets, farms and bird parks, and avoid birds, their droppings and carcasses.

terms.zh: 禽類肉品及蛋都應熟食
terms.en: Cook poultry and eggs thoroughly.

terms.zh: 立百病毒感染症
terms.en: Nipah virus infection

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(近5年禽鳥有檢出H5N1病毒，且有人類感染個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (H5N1 found in birds in the past 5 years, with human cases)

terms.zh: 避免接觸流行地區蝙蝠或豬隻，及其他有可能感染的動物
terms.en: Avoid bats, pigs and other animals that may be infected in affected areas.

terms.zh: 避免食用流行地區可能受感染蝙蝠尿液或唾液污染的水果或椰棗、樹汁等
terms.en: In affected areas, do not eat fruit, dates or tree sap that may be contaminated with bat urine or saliva.

terms.zh: 養成良好的衛生習慣，如勤洗手(尤其是接觸動物後)及食用清洗乾淨之水果
terms.en: Keep good hygiene: wash your hands often (especially after touching animals) and eat only well-washed fruit.

terms.zh: 如需接觸動物時，應採取適當防護措施，如戴手套、口罩及工作服等，尤其是處理生病的動物；接觸後使用肥皂洗手或其他暴露部位
terms.en: If you must handle animals, wear protection such as gloves, a mask and work clothes, especially with sick animals; afterwards wash your hands and any other exposed skin with soap.

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(近5年禽鳥有檢出H5N1病毒)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (H5N1 found in birds in the past 5 years)

terms.zh: 奧羅普切熱
terms.en: Oropouche fever

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(2013年有通報人類H5N1流感個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (a human H5N1 case was reported in 2013)

terms.zh: 新型A型流感
terms.en: Novel influenza A

terms.zh: 登革熱(不含港澳)
terms.en: Dengue fever (excluding Hong Kong and Macao)

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(侷限於東北部黑龍江省、吉林省長白山周邊、內蒙古大興安嶺周邊)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (limited to the north-east: Heilongjiang, around Changbai Mountain in Jilin and the Greater Khingan range in Inner Mongolia)

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(近5年禽鳥有檢出H5N1、H7N9病毒，且均有人類感染個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (H5N1 and H7N9 found in birds in the past 5 years, both with human cases)

terms.zh: 伊波拉病毒感染
terms.en: Ebola virus disease

terms.zh: 伊波拉病毒大多由染病的野生動物感染人類，在當地應避免接觸蝙蝠、靈長類動物及其屍體，並避免接觸感染者的體液
terms.en: Ebola is mostly passed to people from infected wild animals: avoid bats, primates and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.

terms.zh: 在當地應勤用肥皂洗手，若無法取得肥皂及水源，建議應使用至少含60%酒精成份的乾洗手液消毒雙手
terms.en: Wash your hands often with soap; if soap and water are not available, use a hand sanitiser with at least 60% alcohol.

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(侷限於東北部薩瓦河以東地區)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (limited to the north-east, east of the Sava river)

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(侷限於Bornholm島)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (limited to the island of Bornholm)

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(目前仍持續有人類H5N1流感個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (human H5N1 cases are still being reported)

terms.zh: 馬堡病毒出血熱
terms.en: Marburg virus disease

terms.zh: 馬堡病毒出血熱大多由染病的野生動物感染人類，在當地應避免接觸蝙蝠、靈長類動物及其屍體，並避免接觸感染者的體液
terms.en: Marburg virus disease is mostly passed to people from infected wild animals: avoid bats, primates and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(主要侷限於南部地區)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (mainly in the south)

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(北海道南部有少數通報病例)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (a few cases reported in southern Hokkaido)

terms.zh: 中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒感染症
terms.en: MERS-CoV infection

terms.zh: 中東呼吸道冠狀病毒可能會透過駱駝傳染，在當地應避免接觸或騎乘駱駝、生飲駝奶
terms.en: MERS coronavirus can spread through camels: avoid touching or riding camels and drinking raw camel milk.

terms.zh: 新型A型流感(2007年曾通報人類H5N1流感個案)
terms.en: Novel influenza A (a human H5N1 case was reported in 2007)

terms.zh: 拉薩熱
terms.en: Lassa fever

terms.zh: 拉薩熱大多由染病的囓齒類動物感染人類，在當地應避免接觸囓齒類動物及其屍體，並避免接觸感染者的體液
terms.en: Lassa fever is mostly passed to people from infected rodents: avoid rodents and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(主要局限於南部沿海地區)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (mainly along the southern coast)

terms.zh: 蜱媒腦炎(侷限於南部斯德哥爾摩省、烏普薩拉省、南曼蘭省、西約塔蘭省等地區)
terms.en: Tick-borne encephalitis (limited to Stockholm, Uppsala, Södermanland, Västra Götaland and nearby counties)

terms.zh: 登革熱(侷限在南部佛羅里達州及德州地區)
terms.en: Dengue fever (limited to southern Florida and Texas)

terms.zh: 茲卡病毒感染症(侷限於佛羅里達州布勞沃德郡、邁阿密郡、皮尼拉斯郡、棕櫚灘郡)
terms.en: Zika virus infection (limited to Broward, Miami-Dade, Pinellas and Palm Beach counties, Florida)
